mechanism: Phenobarbital is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that increases eslicarbazepine metabolism, reducing its plasma concentrations and efficacy; both drugs also have additive CNS depression effects.
action: Monitor eslicarbazepine serum levels and seizure control closely; consider dose adjustment of eslicarbazepine upward or use alternative antiepileptic agents with fewer interactions; assess for increased CNS adverse effects.
